claims: Got an email from Anthropic (usage/billing) that revealed the waste
Every sub-agent call re-sent the full system prompt, skills and details from scratch each run/day -- 'reading the employee handbook out loud before every task'
Caching the prompt cuts cost; one agent ('Prism') is the exception
how_to_steps: Identify sub-agents that run on loops/routines with large static system prompts
Add prompt caching (cache_control on the static prefix) so each run reuses the cached handbook
Prompt itself is said to be shared but is not visible in the video
